title: On the Amplification of Linguistic Bias through Unintentional Self-reinforcement Learning by Generative Language Models — A Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis and perspective discussion exploring how generative language models amplify subtle biases in vocabulary selection, tone, and writing flow through unintentional self-reinforcement learning loops. As a perspective paper, it relies on conceptual frameworks and literature review rather than conducting empirical measurements.
